title: ADHD overview
text: ADHD is a condition that can affect attention, focus, impulse control, and activity levels in children and adults.

title: ADHD medication side effects
text: ADHD medicines can cause side effects such as appetite loss, sleep problems, headaches, mood changes, and increased heart rate.

title: ADHD treatment options
text: Treatment for ADHD can include behavioral therapy, medication, coaching, school support, and lifestyle routines.

title: Anxiety symptoms
text: Anxiety can cause worry, restlessness, sleep problems, panic attacks, and difficulty concentrating.

title: Heart disease symptoms
text: Heart disease symptoms may include chest pain, shortness of breath, fatigue, dizziness, and swelling in the legs.

title: AWS iam PassRole policy
text: The iam:PassRole permission allows a user or service to pass an IAM role to an AWS service when creating resources.

title: AWS SCP guardrails
text: Service control policies define permission guardrails for accounts in AWS Organizations and can restrict actions across member accounts.

title: OpenSearch BM25 ranking
text: OpenSearch uses BM25 as the default lexical ranking algorithm for matching query terms against indexed documents.

title: Vector search with HNSW
text: HNSW is a graph based approximate nearest neighbor algorithm used for fast vector similarity search.

title: Reranking in RAG
text: A reranker scores query and document pairs after initial retrieval to improve the order of candidate passages for RAG.
